predictions_note: rental 6's registered Q1 predictions verbatim (copied from 2026-10-09-rental6-q1-gh200), so its g_R and A proxies are unchanged; the skew-page pairs read rental7-skew's predictions

statistic.g: per (NATIVE, SHARED) pair on one page: g = (T_S - T_N)_meas - (T_S - T_N)_v3, us, T_v3 carried to the page's own A (r6model.reprice); a page with no align_probe: its SHARED cells are NOT SCORED in Q1-H and Q1-P
statistic.se: cluster-robust (CR1) on (model, n): se^2 = C / (C - 1) x sum_c (sum_i in c (g_i - mean))^2 / N^2
statistic.g_R: rival R's per-pair (S - N)_R - (S - N)_v3 from the registered predictions (both carried to the page's A), averaged over the SAME valid pairs

Q1-H.rule: v3 HOLDS iff |mean g| <= 1.5 us (pair-weighted) AND the copies clause (|d| <= 1.5 us, d the pair-weighted mean over models with valid Q1 pairs at both c9 and c15 of mean g(c15) - mean g(c9)); the copies clause undecided leaves v3 UNDECIDED (FAILS if the level clause fails); a rival is EXCLUDED iff |mean g - g_R| > 3 se and > 1.5 us, scored whenever 6 pairs and 3 clusters are valid WHATEVER the copies clause reads (owner decision 2); se CR1 on (model, n) and at least 3 clusters, else UNDECIDED
Q1-H.not_separated: v3_all is not separated from v3 by construction (g_R 0 on every block-scan pair): stated here, not discovered

power.model: g = anchor(cluster) + tau x N(0,1) per cluster + sigma(cluster) x N(0,1) per pair (+ g_R of the true rival; + a c15 effect on c15 Q1 pairs); no pair losses (r7 lost no held cell)
power.label: SEEN inputs (design-r7 3.2 and design-r7-review work/seen_g_clusters.json, mc_q1h.py)

Q1-C.cell: Qwen1.5 SHARED n 1 (NATIVE block-scan), c9 and c15 Q1 pages; x = g of that pair
Q1-C.statistic: D = x15 - x9 (owner, review (e)): a board shift common to the two pages cancels

rivals.DEAD: D = (ratio - 1) x9, ratio = dead CTAs c15 / c9 = 66272 / 39824 = 1.664122
rivals.ZERO: x9 = 0: printed only (SEEN x9 already reads -7.95 / -5.97 us)
rivals.OVERLAP: partial host overlap at n 1 (rental 3): predicts what CALL predicts; printed as such

Q1-C.rule: the nearer of CALL and DEAD to D is SELECTED if the other is more than 2 se_D farther; else NOT SEPARATED; positions are functions of the MEASURED x9 (review (h) 5); se_D = sqrt2 x 0.45 us (Qwen1.5 replicate, SEEN)
Q1-C.host_margin: Qwen1.5 NATIVE n 1 is 339.6 us + F240 = 407 us against the 0.40 ms cut: the rule reads the REGISTERED prediction, so a faster board does not void the cell (the page's timer flag still can)
Q1-C.note: rental 6's rule verbatim (D = x15 - x9 at Qwen1.5 SHARED n 1)

Q1-P.population: small-batch NATIVE pairs passing the host rule: Phi n 1 (Q1 c9, c15), Mixtral n 3 controls on the rental-7 pages A, B, C

Q1-SK.status: OPEN, printed: mean g over Phi n 2 skewed pairs minus mean g over the same pages' Phi n 2 control pairs

gates: as rental7-skew (G1 under r7-median-run3, 6 of 9 clean, G2 host rule + timer flag, G4 1705, G5); views ALL and CLEAN; the P20 view printed

labels.c15: SHARED BLIND; NATIVE SEEN (it declares E at any copies count)

scorer_ambiguities.1 the registered rule and where it runs: r7-median-run3 (S_med plus the run guard, owner decision 1), applied by the scorer to cells.csv (r7common.rebuild); R3 is unchanged and runs --slip-policy cell --min-clean-repeats 0; a page that ran another min-clean is NOT SCORED
scorer_ambiguities.2 S_med's G1 drift clause: the run guard excludes a repeat (3 or more consecutive reads a step under the lock); G1 fails on drift only past 10% non-clean repeat rows (slipped, run-guarded or not ok); the endpoint flag is recorded only
scorer_ambiguities.3 the P20 side view: rebuilt from the same cells.csv with today's exclusions: its own medians, clocks, host flags and lost cells (6 of 9), G1's clock clauses on its kept cells and the 20% ceiling; DESCRIPTIVE, every test printed on it
scorer_ambiguities.4 per-shape E1: read in each view on that view's cells; the registered verdict holds only if both views hold; a shape is CERTIFIED in CLEAN only with at least 2 of its 3 pages in CLEAN and its CLEAN cells meeting the bar
scorer_ambiguities.5 Q1-H se with few clusters: CR1 on (model, n) clusters needs at least 3 clusters; fewer is UNDECIDED (no C / (C - 1) with C = 1); the registered population has 5
scorer_ambiguities.6 pair or cluster weights: pair-weighted mean (rental 6's); the equal-cluster-weight mean is printed
scorer_ambiguities.7 the copies clause: matched by model: per model with valid Q1 pairs at both c9 and c15, mean g(c15) - mean g(c9), pair-weighted over those models; identical to rental 6's unmatched means when all six Q1 pages are valid
scorer_ambiguities.8 one copies side only: the copies clause is UNDECIDED; v3 reads UNDECIDED (FAILS if its level clause fails); the rivals are still scored (owner decision 2)
scorer_ambiguities.9 the share denominator: every timed repeat row of the page in cells.csv (R3 at min-clean 0 times all 9 of every cell); cells.csv's rows per cell must equal the report's repeat_rows, else NOT SCORED
scorer_ambiguities.10 l2open: rows are (cell, arm) on w1 only for the verdict (PT, PW skewed; uniform and balanced printed), NATIVE and SHARED at n <= 9 and NATIVE at n 16; w2 under v3 printed; rental 6's counter clock rule; one page, one view

seen_data: every c9 and skew-page control pair is a SEEN replicate
